title: 第661章 他成通缉犯了第660章 你们的仇人就是我们的仇人
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
得到众人的保证，云星落很满意。
她抬手取出一张密密麻麻写满灵药名称的清单，凌空推向众人。
清单之上，除了炼制帝运丹的核心灵药，她还悄悄添了许多世间罕见，价值连城的上古珍稀药草。
既然有人主动卖命帮她寻宝，她自然要好好利用。
“清单在此，诸位照着寻找即可。”
二十来名大能纷纷把清单收好，这些药草可是关乎他们的帝运丹，他们自然上心。
“小友放心，我等定不负所托！”
云星落淡淡开口：“既然如此，诸位前辈，我们即刻动身前往魔族。”
“你们无需现身，全程隐匿身形，暗中随行护道即可。”
“好！”
二十名入圣大能齐齐应声，身形一晃，瞬间隐匿虚空，气息全无，默默潜藏在四周暗处，随时待命。
一切安排妥当，云星落转头看向身旁的夜葬、霍小棠、叶凌霜三人。
“我们也走。”
四人坐到飞舟之上，一路呼啸朝着魔族地界的方向疾驰而去。
一路飞行，夜葬等人依旧满心震撼，久久无法平复。
他们怎么也想不到，这次看似凶险万分的古族之行，竟然有收获如此巨大。
不仅逼得巫族和雷族赔付天价的灵石，还派出强者护航，更是拿下了十万大山数十个上古古族族长的天道人情！
日后无论遭遇何等危机，随便捏碎一张人情卡，便有顶尖古族大能驰援。
此行魔族，哪怕再凶险，他们也已然有了最大的底气。
霍小棠满眼崇拜，忍不住感慨：“小师妹也太厉害了，硬生生把一场死局，变成了天大的机缘！”

叶凌霜微微点头，由衷赞叹：“人情、助力、机缘，尽数拿捏，这格局与心智，我等远远不及。”
夜葬目光坚定，沉声道：“跟着小师妹，此行魔族，必定无碍！”
“好了，少拍马屁了，大师兄，你对魔族熟悉，先想想，我们第一战应该到哪里，总不能一到魔族就杀到魔宫里去吧？”
这话落下，夜葬瞬间收敛心神，眉头微微蹙起，陷入短暂的沉默。
冷风拂过四人的衣袍，带着魔界边界独有的凛冽煞气，气氛瞬间沉静下来。
片刻后，夜葬才缓缓开口：“当然不能，就我们几个人的修为，看着战力不俗，但在魔界根本不够看，说白了就是一群小喽啰。”
“别说正面抗衡魔尊了，我们恐怕连魔宫千里范围都靠近不了，就会被瞬间剿灭。”
content_en:
Yun Xingluo was very satisfied with everyone's assurance.
She raised her hand and took out a list filled with the names of elixirs, and pushed it to everyone.
On the list, in addition to the core elixir for refining the Emperor's Luck Pill, she also quietly added many rare and priceless ancient rare herbs.
Since someone was willing to work hard to help her hunt for treasure, she naturally wanted to take advantage of it.
"Here is the list, just follow it and look for it."
Twenty or so powerful men put the lists away one after another. These herbs were related to their Emperor Luck Pills, so they naturally took them seriously.
"Don't worry, little friend, I will definitely live up to your trust!"
Yun Xingluo said calmly: "In that case, seniors, we will leave for the Demon Clan immediately."
"You don't need to show up, just stay hidden throughout the whole process and follow us secretly to protect the way."
"Okay!"
Twenty saintly masters responded in unison, their bodies swayed, and they instantly disappeared into the void, without any breath, silently hiding in the darkness around them, ready for action at any time.
After everything was arranged, Yun Xingluo turned to look at Ye Zang, Huo Xiaotang, and Ye Lingshuang beside her.
"Let's go too."
The four people sat on the flying boat and roared all the way towards the direction of the demon clan's realm.
All the way flying, Ye Burian and others were still shocked and unable to recover for a long time.
They never imagined that this seemingly dangerous trip to the ancient clan would yield such huge rewards.
Not only did they force the Wu Clan and the Thunder Clan to pay exorbitant prices for the spirit stones, but they also sent powerful men to escort them, and even won the favor of dozens of ancient clan chiefs in Shiwan Mountain!
No matter what kind of crisis you encounter in the future, just crush a favor card, and the top ancient clan will come to your aid.
No matter how dangerous this trip to the demon clan is, they already have the greatest confidence.
Huo Xiaotang was full of admiration and couldn't help but sigh: "Junior sister is so amazing, she turned a dead situation into a huge opportunity!"
Ye Lingshuang nodded slightly and admired sincerely: "Favours, help, opportunities, all of them are taken care of. This structure and mentality are far beyond what I can expect."
Ye Zang's eyes were firm and he said in a deep voice: "Follow my junior sister, this trip to the demon clan will be fine!"
"Okay, stop flattering me. Senior brother, you are familiar with the Demon Clan. Think about where we should go for the first battle. We can't just kill the Demon Clan and go to the Demon Palace as soon as we arrive, right?"
After saying these words, Ye Zang immediately concentrated his mind, frowned slightly, and fell into a brief silence.
The cold wind blew through the robes of the four people, bringing with it the cold and evil aura unique to the border of the demon world, and the atmosphere instantly calmed down.
After a moment, Ye Zang slowly spoke: "Of course not. With the cultivation of a few of us, we seem to have good combat power, but it is not enough to be seen in the demon world. To put it bluntly, we are just a group of minions."
"Don't talk about confronting the Demon Lord head-on. I'm afraid we won't even be able to get close to the Demon Palace within a thousand miles, and we will be wiped out instantly."
